change_control.review_note: Australian Working Holiday baseline verified against the current Embassy of Japan in Australia guidance and MOFA programme page.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: Australian citizen currently living in Australia

summary_facts.label: Main purpose
summary_facts.value: Holiday in Japan; work is incidental

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: A$2,500 single applicant; additional return-flight funds if no paid return ticket

eligibility_rules.label: Are you an Australian citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Australian route is for Australian citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you currently living in Australia?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Australian applicants must currently live in Australia to use this Working Holiday route.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The current Australian Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Employment must be incidental to the holiday rather than the primary purpose.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependent children accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Australian Working Holiday route does not permit accompanying children.

eligibility_rules.label: Do you hold a valid Australian passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: A valid Australian passport is required.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the programme's good-health and good-character requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme includes good-health and good-character requirements.

funds_rule.no_ticket_note: If you only have a one-way ticket or no flights purchased, the Embassy requires additional funds sufficient to purchase the return flight but does not publish one fixed extra amount.

jurisdiction.label: Japanese Embassy/Consulate responsible for your Australian residence
jurisdiction.description: Working Holiday applicants must apply in Australia. Use the Japanese diplomatic mission responsible for where you live and follow that mission's current lodgement instructions.

document_checklist.title: Valid Australian passport
document_checklist.description: Original valid Australian passport plus the passport photo-page copy requested by the current guidance.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form and photo
document_checklist.description: Complete the current visa form and attach a recent passport photograph following the mission's current instructions.

document_checklist.title: Flight details
document_checklist.description: Provide flight details to Japan and back to Australia. A one-way ticket is acceptable only with sufficient additional funds for the return flight.

document_checklist.title: Resume
document_checklist.description: Resume covering personal, educational and employment history.

document_checklist.title: Proposed schedule
document_checklist.description: Use the official proposed-schedule format and complete the first six months with concrete travel activities.

document_checklist.title: Statement of Purpose
document_checklist.description: A signed and dated statement explaining why you want to visit Japan as a Working Holiday maker.

document_checklist.title: Proof of funds
document_checklist.description: Recent three-month Australian bank statement meeting the current funds guidance and showing your name.

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current Australian official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Re-open the Embassy/Consulate guidance immediately before preparing your application.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm the Japanese mission responsible for your residence
preparation_checklist.description: Application instructions and appointments can differ by mission within Australia.

preparation_checklist.title: Build a travel-focused proposed schedule
preparation_checklist.description: The programme is for a holiday in Japan; work is incidental rather than the main purpose.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Requirements and appointment arrangements can change; compare your pack with the responsible mission's current instructions.
